chunks: And it is narrated from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUmar ibn Abī Shuʿbah, from Abī Shuʿbah:
That he saw Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام eating while sitting cross-legged.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, the kunyah of Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَبِي شُعْبَةَ: Abī Shuʿbah, the reporting narrator in this hadith
key_terms.حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ: Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, a narrator in the sanad/isnad (chain of narrators)
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicates reported transmission

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام sit while eating?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an observed practice of Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام while eating. It indicates a manner of sitting at meals and contributes to the transmitted etiquette and sunnah (prophetic tradition) of eating in Shia hadith literature.
